solver_policy.selection_rule: Smallest validated timestep >= actual scene.timestep; beyond maximum use maximum and warn. Float32 equality uses relative tolerance 1e-7. Explicit caller override takes precedence. Selection occurs only at load time.
solver_policy.meaning: Numerical solver strategy, not a mechanical parameter; untested intermediate timesteps are assigned a strategy, not certified.
solver_policy.group_scope: Per-articulation properties; connected contact islands and batched unrelated islands can inherit the maximum iteration count.
